_note: Crusnik 40% form (Milestone 7 ability). Unlocked by the flag below (reading the Crusnik legend in the Forgotten Reliquary). The blood meter fills as Abel's hits land and enemies fall; when full, ABIL transforms him. While transformed the meter drains; at zero he returns to the priest form. In Crusnik form ABIL throws the chain lash (attack 'lash'). Times in ms, speeds px/s.
